domain: R with CommRing R, every n:Nat, every explicit row data b:Nat -> Fin n -> R

definitions.state0: state b 0 U = if U=empty then 1 else 0
definitions.state_step: state b (k+1) U = sum j in U, b k j * state b k (U.erase j)
definitions.rowProduct: rowProduct b 0=1; rowProduct b (k+1)=linearForm(b k)*rowProduct b k
definitions.subsetExponent: sum j in U Finsupp.single j 1
definitions.linearForm: sum j:Fin n C(c j)*X j
definitions.matrixRows: if k<n then B (Fin.mk k h) j else 0, for arbitrary B:Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R

required.initial_state: forall b,U, state b 0 U=if U=empty then 1 else 0
required.step_state: forall b,k,U, state b (k+1) U=sum j in U,b k j*state b k(U.erase j)
required.coefficient_invariant: forall b,k,U, state b k U=(rowProduct b k).coeff(subsetExponent U)
required.terminal_permutation: forall b, state b n univ=sum sigma:Perm(Fin n), product i:Fin n,b i.val(sigma i)
required.terminal_matrix: forall B, state(matrixRows B)n univ=sum sigma:Perm(Fin n), product i:Fin n,B i(sigma i)
required.marked_central: forall n>=2,A rational matrix, state(matrixRows(markedWeights A))n univ=(markedHhat A).coeff(centralDegree n)

state_space: All 2^n column subsets; exponential, no polynomial-size claim
